title: Supremum norm on a finite product
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The product supremum norm of $f$ is the maximum of $|f(x)|$ over all inputs $x\in\Omega^n$.
